event_summary: 1717年、ドレスデンの宮廷はフランス随一の鍵盤奏者ルイ・マルシャンと、当時まだ地方の無名に近い存在だったバッハとの対決を企画した。しかし本番前夜、マルシャンは姿を消してパリへ帰り、バッハは不戦勝となった。
hook_copy: [G]世紀の鍵盤対決[/G]、相手は[R]当日の朝にはもう街にいなかった[/R]
portrait_prompt: Illustrated cinematic style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic portrait of Johann Sebastian Bach, based directly on the attached historical portrait (the Haussmann-type portrait): a heavyset German man around sixty years old with a stern, rounded, slightly fleshy face, a soft double chin, heavy-lidded dark eyes, thick dark eyebrows, a small pursed mouth with faint rosy cheeks, and a prominent nose. He wears a long, voluminous white full-bottomed wig with tight tubular curls cascading past the shoulders on both sides, parted in the center with height at the crown. His clothing is a plain dark (black/charcoal) coat with a row of ornate round metal buttons down the front, a soft white ruffled cravat and lace cuffs visible at the wrist, no embroidery or gold trim beyond the plain metal buttons already present. He holds a small sheet of handwritten music in one hand near his chest. Bust-to-shoulder composition, facing slightly to one side with a calm, dignified, faintly confident expression. Background is a plain, muted, neutral dark tone with no texture or scenery. No text, no watermark, no visible canvas cracks or aging effects. The painting fills the entire frame edge to edge with no border, no vignette, and no empty margin around the figure.

middle_slides.text: 1717年9月、ザクセン選帝侯の宮廷があるドレスデンに、ヨハン・ゼバスティアン・バッハとフランス宮廷随一の奏者ルイ・マルシャンが同時に滞在していた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. A grand Baroque Dresden street scene in September 1717, sandstone palace facades and church spires in the background, early autumn light. In the foreground stands Johann Sebastian Bach, a stocky German composer in his early thirties, with the same facial structure as the reference portrait (stern rounded face, heavy-lidded dark eyes, slightly flushed cheeks, small mouth) but youthful and unlined skin, no double chin, wearing a plain curled white periwig and a modest dark coat with plain cuffs, carrying a leather document case, looking up thoughtfully at the grand court buildings as he arrives in the city. No other people, no text, no signage.

middle_slides.text: 宮廷は二人の鍵盤対決を企画し、街中が「どちらが勝つか」と噂した。名声では、フランス宮廷の名手マルシャンのほうが上だと見られていた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. The interior of an opulent Baroque court hall in Dresden, gilded columns, tapestries and a large ornate harpsichord positioned in the center under candlelight and tall windows. Johann Sebastian Bach, a stocky composer in his early thirties with the same facial features as the reference portrait (rounded face, heavy-lidded dark eyes, small mouth) but youthful unlined skin, wearing a plain curled white periwig and modest dark coat, stands beside the harpsichord examining it closely with a focused, slightly tense expression, alone in the vast hall, anticipating the upcoming contest. No other people, no text.

middle_slides.text: ところが対決前夜、宮廷随一の花形だったはずのマルシャンは、荷物をまとめて宿を引き払い、そのままパリへ向けて姿を消してしまった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: An oil-painting style scene at dawn on a cobblestone street in early-18th-century Dresden: a dark horse-drawn travelling coach loaded with luggage is pulling away from an inn, heading out of the city. The coach windows are covered by drawn curtains, so no passenger is visible. Misty blue early-morning light, baroque church spires in the background, the street otherwise empty. Painterly brushwork, not photorealistic, no text anywhere in the image.

middle_slides.text: 対決はバッハの不戦勝に終わった。この一件は長く語り草となり、ドイツの鍵盤奏者としてのバッハの名声を大きく高める出来事となった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. A grand Baroque court hall bathed in warm morning light streaming through tall windows, an ornate harpsichord in the center of the room. Johann Sebastian Bach, a stocky composer in his early thirties with the same facial features as the reference portrait (rounded face, heavy-lidded dark eyes, small mouth) but youthful unlined skin, wearing a plain curled white periwig and modest dark coat with plain cuffs, is seated confidently at the harpsichord, hands poised over the keys, a composed and quietly triumphant expression on his face as light illuminates him from the front. No other people, no text.

fb_caption:
1717年9月、ドレスデンの貴族の館に、宮廷中の注目を集めた鍵盤対決の噂が広がっていた。だが主役のはずだったフランス随一の奏者ルイ・マルシャンは本番前夜に姿を消し、対戦相手バッハの不戦勝で幕を閉じた。🎹

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

YouTubeでは、この作曲家の物語を動画でもお届けしています。https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ZhJRZyvEc0
